card: This pull request moves atomic file replacement into common::WriteSettings by writing to a temporary .tmp file and replacing the destination via RenameOver. Previously, banlist.json was overwritten directly in place, risking a truncated or empty file if the node crashed or ran out of disk space during writing, which would drop all peer bans on the next restart. It also cleans up custom temporary-file logic in ArgsManager::WriteSettingsFile and adds unit tests covering atomic writes and rename failures.
changed_since_previous: The implementation remains focused on common::WriteSettings; the test suite now verifies that repeated failed writes reuse the existing .tmp file rather than leaving multiple temporary files.
evidence: Commit 4a0f4916f6 explains: 'If the node crashed during the write, or the write failed because the disk was full, banlist.json could be left empty or partly written. On the next startup the ban list would fail to load and all bans would be dropped.'
problem: CBanDB::Write wrote banlist.json directly in place via WriteSettings without an atomic replacement step. An untimely crash or disk-full failure during a write could leave banlist.json truncated or empty, discarding all peer bans on next startup. Meanwhile, ArgsManager handled its own settings.json.tmp writing and renaming separately.

risk.why: A flaw in the temporary file writing or rename logic could cause settings.json or banlist.json to fail to persist across restarts.

scope_notes: The PR title and description claim common::WriteSettings was renamed to common::WriteJson, but the patch keeps the WriteSettings name and only updates log messages to refer to 'JSON file'.
summary: Moves temporary file creation and atomic rename logic directly into common::WriteSettings, writing to a .tmp file and replacing the destination with RenameOver. This makes banlist.json writes atomic without modifying callers, and eliminates duplicate temporary-file handling in ArgsManager::WriteSettingsFile.
uncertainties: The PR description states WriteSettings was renamed to WriteJson, but the diff does not include this rename.
